description: A ground-level photograph capturing a wide, calm body of water in the foreground and midground, reflecting the clear blue sky. On the right side of the midground, a patch of low-lying, green, marshy vegetation is visible, indicative of a salt marsh or brackish reed bed. Further across the water, a sloping hillside densely covered with green trees and some scattered buildings can be seen. In the far distance, more hills and structures are visible under a mostly clear sky with a few wispy clouds. The scene represents a natural coastal or estuarine environment, aligned with the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) descriptions of salt marshes and estuaries.
